data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2: (a) Guard scope expanded — _audit_dso_id_label_writes covers action in {create, update, DELETE} (not just create/update). Unauthorized DELETE of dso-id labels is also prohibited; only inbound_clean_label may delete dso-id labels. Closes the e2e_coverage gap from cycle 2. (b) RED test isolation: monkey-patch _load_acli to return a no-op stub client + patch _load_concurrency. Reference existing tests/unit/dso_reconciler/conftest.py baseline for fixture pattern. Ensures RED failure is deterministic (guard absent), not infra-noise. (c) DSO_DSO_ID_GUARD_MODE resolution order: read os.environ first; fallback to dso-config.conf key dso_id_guard_mode; env var takes precedence. Document precedence in module docstring.
